Court hears Ann Widdecombe murder suspect motivated by political hostility

A court has heard that the suspect in the murder of Ann Widdecombe was motivated by political and ideological hostility, specifically towards the Reform party. The prosecution stated that the suspect harbored animosity towards the political group.
